mission: 1.61 — Anchor Lineage Confirmation & Partner Documentation Recovery V1

canonical_baseline.$comment: Measured live against the deployment before any work. Section 0 requires the measurement rather than a quotation from a mission report.

scope_freeze.$comment: Section 1. Exactly four apparatus subjects, named by Mission 1.60 and not extended here.

dropped_apparatus.name: Censys
dropped_apparatus.why_not_reconsidered: Section 1 forbids reviving it, and its mismatch is an established fact on first-party documentation from both sides rather than an unknown a new document could resolve.

what_this_mission_answers.$comment: Stated before the work, so the record cannot be read afterwards as having answered a larger question.
what_this_mission_answers.it_should_answer: Do we possess enough affirmative first-party evidence to qualify the anchor as a measurement apparatus, and enough working documentation paths to evaluate the three existing partner candidates in the next pair-selection mission?

documentation_ledger.$comment: Section 27. Anchor at most 8, three partners at most 12, 20 overall. Every entry is a documentation page; none is a query, a count, a facet or a host record.

value_exposure.$comment: Section 33 and the Mission 1.60 rules. PREREGISTERED is defined against retrieval, so one measurement fetched here would make an honest preregistration impossible for ever.
value_exposure.the_trial_is_not_free: A zero-cost trial, demo console, search preview or sample explorer destroys preregistration exactly as a paid one would. Access cost is irrelevant to epistemic contamination.
value_exposure.the_count_is_not_metadata: A query returning only a number still returns a measurement value about the target population.
